card.name: Words introducing adverse reaction statements
card.fires_on: Linking or subject words right before a verb in label safety statements, such as 'The following', 'reactions have', or 'When pregnancy'. Often follows a section heading like Postmarketing Experience or Pregnancy.

modes.label: Postmarketing lead-in
modes.description: Words in the stock sentence 'The following adverse reactions have been identified'.
modes.example: 6.2 Postmarketing Experience The<< following>> adverse reactions have been identified during postapproval

modes.label: Conditional warning openers
modes.description: The subject or comma in 'When pregnancy is detected' or 'If superinfection occurs', just before the instruction.
modes.example: ( 2.2 , 4.1 , 5.1 , 8.1 , 8.3 ). • When<< pregnancy>> is detected, discontinue ambrisent

modes.label: Heading then noun
modes.description: A noun directly after a numbered section heading, before the reports are described.
modes.example: 5.1 Acute Renal Failure<< Cases>> of acute renal failure have been reported in

card.writes: It seems to add a verb that reports or states something happened, such as 'reportedly' or 'conceded'.
card.plain: It fires on the words just before a label says that something was reported or that an action should be taken.
